narrative: Day 7 is a cold, wet Tuesday with rain over the Navoi region, but nobody is at the Qizilqum site yet, so the weather costs nothing beyond confirming that the 20 December survey start needs a dry-weather contingency. In the Tashkent office Aziz Karimov chairs the first internal HEP weekly progress meeting, which reviews the PEP Rev A comments, the baseline inputs due today and the two critical items (the 220/33 kV transformer R-001 and the geotechnical/Basic Design float R-003). Aziz also issues the Progress Measurement and Reporting Procedure. Elena Petrova writes to the State Construction Inspectorate to request survey access and land allocation confirmation ahead of A110, A210 and A220.
